tagline.zh: 衬线 × 无衬线的对比搭配,或同字族多字重的单字族策略:核心是对比、职责分离与克制——最多两种字体,第三种之前先问职责。
tagline.en: Serif × sans contrast pairing, or the single-family multi-weight strategy: contrast, separated duties and restraint — two typefaces at most, and question the third.

origin.zh: 官方入口是 Google Fonts Knowledge「Choosing type」栏目(调研 12§9:页面 JS 渲染,正文未能核验);可核的官方立场出自 Apple HIG Typography:「Minimize the number of typefaces you use」——全站一个字族(SF 系),层级只动 size/weight/color(调研 01,官网原文已核);Vercel Geist 以 Sans/Serif/Mono/Pixel 四族同源发行(调研 05§25)。搭配方法论细则为社区实践共识,未证实。
origin.en: The official entry point is Google Fonts Knowledge's 'Choosing type' section (research 12 §9: JS-rendered page, body text could not be verified); the verifiable official stance comes from Apple HIG Typography: 'Minimize the number of typefaces you use' — one family site-wide (the SF system), hierarchy driven only by size/weight/color (research 01, HIG original verified). Vercel ships Geist as four same-source families: Sans/Serif/Mono/Pixel (research 05 §25). The pairing methodology details are community practice, unverified.

label.zh: 衬线标题 × 无衬线正文
无衬线标题 × 衬线正文

effect.zh: JS 型参数(切 data-pairing)。三组演示搭配:衬线×无衬线(经典对比)、反向搭配(杂志正文衬线)、单字族(Inter Variable 仅动字重,Apple HIG 一字族原则)。前两档的衬线用系统衬线栈(Georgia → 宋体 → serif),零第三方依赖。
effect.en: JS-type param (toggles data-pairing). Three demo pairings: serif × sans (classic contrast), the reversed pairing (magazine-style serif body), and single-family (Inter Variable weights only, per Apple HIG's one-family principle). The serif in the first two modes is a system stack (Georgia → Songti/SimSun → serif), zero third-party dependencies.

effect.zh: 标题字号。『标题字体只用于大字号』是搭配方法论的通则(社区实践,未证实);调到 24px 以下时衬线标题与正文的对比感消失,搭配退化为『换了字体的正文』。
effect.en: Heading size. 'Display faces only for large sizes' is a pairing rule of thumb (community practice, unverified); below ~24px the serif heading loses its contrast against the body and the pairing degrades into 'body text with a different font'.

effect.zh: 标题字重。单字族模式由 Inter Variable 的 wght 100–900 轴真实驱动(调研 05§24 已核);系统衬线栈通常只有 400/700 两档,其余档位由浏览器合成或钳制到最近档——字重对比在衬线档可能失真,如实演示。
effect.en: Heading weight. In single-family mode it is driven by Inter Variable's real wght 100–900 axis (research 05 §24, verified); system serif stacks usually carry only 400/700, with other values synthesized or clamped by the browser — weight contrast may be distorted on the serif modes, shown as-is.

note.zh: 无 CSS 新特性:font-family/font-weight 属最基础能力;系统衬线栈(Georgia/Songti/SimSun/serif 泛型)全平台可用,但具体衬线字形因平台而异;可变字重需字体含 wght 轴(本站 Inter Variable 已内置)。
note.en: No modern CSS dependency: font-family/font-weight are the most basic capabilities; system serif stacks (Georgia/Songti/SimSun/generic serif) work everywhere but the exact serif glyphs vary by platform; variable weights need a wght axis (already shipped by this site's Inter Variable).

fallback.zh: font-family 列表永远以泛型(serif/sans-serif)收尾:列表逐级回退,中文衬线在无 Georgia 字形的平台落到宋体一类系统衬线,再落到泛型 serif;绝不依赖单一字体名。字重合成时视觉可能发虚,关键层级建议钳制到字体实际提供的档位。
fallback.en: Always end the font-family list with a generic (serif/sans-serif): the list falls through level by level — CJK serif lands on system serifs like Songti where Georgia lacks CJK glyphs, then the generic serif; never depend on a single font name. Synthesized weights can look smudgy — clamp key hierarchy to weights the font actually ships.

use.zh: 编辑/杂志式页面:衬线大标题 + 无衬线正文,氛围与可读性分工
use.en: Editorial/magazine pages: serif display headlines over sans body — mood and readability split the duties

use.zh: 产品官网 hero:无衬线大字 + 品牌调性一致的正文字族
use.en: Product-site heroes: sans display plus a body family consistent with the brand voice

use.zh: 工具型产品的单字族策略:一个可变字族 + 字重/字号/色彩分层级(Apple HIG 原则)
use.en: Tool products' single-family strategy: one variable family with size/weight/color carrying hierarchy (Apple HIG principle)

use.zh: 长文阅读场景:正文候选字体必须先过长文阅读测试(通则,未证实)
use.en: Long-form reading: any body candidate must pass a long-form reading test first (rule of thumb, unverified)

avoid.zh: 两种以上字体堆叠——职责分离后仍加第三种字体是方法论明令禁止项(社区共识,未证实)
avoid.en: Stacking three or more typefaces — adding a third after duties are separated is an explicit methodology violation (community consensus, unverified)

avoid.zh: 两个气质相近的字族『伪搭配』——对比不足时读者只感到混乱而非层次(实践共识,未证实)
avoid.en: Two near-identical voices in a 'fake pairing' — without contrast readers sense mess, not hierarchy (community practice, unverified)

avoid.zh: 标题字体拿来排长正文——展示字族的字号谱系不支持小字号阅读
avoid.en: Using a display family for long body text — display fonts are not designed for small-size reading

a11y.zh: 层级不得只靠字体族区分——Apple HIG 要求字号/字重/色彩同时参与(调研 01,已核);衬线标题字重 ≤300 时浅底可读性明显下降;大面积衬线正文在低分屏上的小字号辨识度需实测;字体加载失败时回退栈的度量差异可能引起文本重排(配合 font-display-strategy 条目的后备字体思路)。
a11y.en: Never encode hierarchy in the family alone — Apple HIG requires size/weight/color to participate (research 01, verified); serif headings at ≤300 weight lose legibility on light backgrounds; serif body at small sizes on low-DPI screens needs real testing; metric mismatches in the fallback stack can reflow text (pair with the font-display-strategy entry's fallback thinking).

goal.zh: 排版一张编辑风文章卡:标题/正文按选定的搭配策略使用两个字族(或单字族多字重),层级同时由字号、字重与色彩承载,并标注当前策略与回退栈。
goal.en: Compose an editorial article card where heading/body follow the chosen pairing strategy (two families, or one family with multiple weights), hierarchy carried by size, weight and color simultaneously, with the current strategy and fallback stack labeled.

acceptance.zh: 最多两种字体;font-family 以泛型 serif/sans-serif 收尾
acceptance.en: At most two typefaces; font-family lists end with a generic serif/sans-serif

acceptance.zh: 衬线栈覆盖中文:Georgia, Songti SC, SimSun, serif 一类跨平台列表
acceptance.en: The serif stack covers CJK: a cross-platform list like Georgia, Songti SC, SimSun, serif

acceptance.zh: 层级不只靠字族:标题与正文同时拉开字号(≥1.5×)与字重
acceptance.en: Hierarchy never rests on family alone: heading and body differ in size (≥1.5×) and weight at once

acceptance.zh: 单字族模式用真实可变字重(Inter Variable wght),不依赖合成加粗
acceptance.en: Single-family mode uses real variable weights (Inter Variable wght), not synthesized bolding
